lines.t: The Sun Is Setting
our hearts, our voices rise. Adonai reigns, His truth never dies. From the rising to the fading
light, His word restores, His spirit ignites. We dance in joy, our hearts made new. Kodesh,
All glory to You
Shabbat shalom, sing hallelujah
The King is here, Yahushua
Rest in His promise, His mercy flows
Forever His love in our souls will grow
The weary find peace on this holy ground
The trumpet of truth is a healing sound
He calls His people, come be restored
Lift up your eyes, behold your Lord
From the valley to the mountain high
His spirit moves, His truth draws nigh
The light of life shines clear and true
Adonai Tzvat, we worship You
Shabbat Shalom, sing Hallelujah
The King is here, Yahushua
Rest in His promise, His mercy flows
Forever His love in our souls will grow
Let every heart prepare His way
Let every soul rejoice this day
Justice and mercy hand in hand
Calling His children across the land
Shabbat shalom, sing hallelujah
Alleluia, the King is here, Yahushua
Peace everlasting, love ever true
Glory and power belong to You
Adonai is holy, His light will stay
Kodesh forever, we praise Your name
Shabbat shalom, let the nations sing
All honor and praise to the mighty King
